reviews.title: Live TV No Longer Supported
reviews.text:
When is this Plexmare going to end?!?!?

It’s clear Plex doesn’t care about Live TV.

If a show is currently being recorded by Plex DVR and I start watching after the recording has begun, I no longer get the option to “Watch from Beginning.”

I also cannot rewind to any point before I started watching. The timeline shows that the earlier portion of the program exists, but attempting to rewind simply returns playback to the point where I originally started watching.

This happens on both:
• Plex for iOS
• Plex for Apple TV / tvOS

However, Plex Web works correctly. If I access the same recording-in-progress through a web browser, I can start watching from the beginning.

Once the recording has finished, the entire recording is also available normally.

So the recording itself and the DVR appear to be working correctly; the problem seems specific to the iOS/tvOS clients when accessing a recording that is still in progress.

This is particularly problematic for sports and other live programs, where I often start watching 15–30 minutes late specifically so I can begin from the start and skip commercials.

reviews.title: Used to be the best player for Plex server
reviews.text: Oh Plex, this used to be the best player for Plex but since the new version it’s most definitely not. The new “unified code” across all platforms has meant it’s become a second rate app that feels like it’s been vibe-coded. Whilst the interface is more “modern” whatever the hell that means. It’s not intuitive like the old app. DVR functions like turning ad-skipping or auto deleting ad-breaks seem only to be possible in the web interface and deleting episodes seem to be hidden so deep in sub-menus as to be impractical. As for the AppleTV version, why you chose to reinvent the wheel by using your own media player over the native appleTV media player is beyond belief, putting far too much load on the device meaning extended use leads to the device running hot. Audio and subtitles sync also seem to have gone, so, for audio sync you have to go in and change it manually on your TV or AV amp but forget about tying to get subtitles working in sync! If you use the live TV functionality and you start watching a show you’re recording a couple of minutes late you are no longer offered the choice to start watching from the beginning of the show. So, if you have  Plex server, consider one of the alternative player apps, you’ll not look back. Go to the Plex support forums if you want to see what long term users are saying about the new app! reviews.title: After Sep2026 redesign, steer clear
reviews.text:
I have been a Plex user for over 10 years, with a lifetime Plex Pass for multiple. Until 2 weeks ago, it was the best Apple TV experience for self-hosted media.  The latest redesign completely changed the UI, discontinued use of the native Apple TV player, broke features, took away features, and made other features more difficult to access. In a forum thread with over 200 replies complaining about the issues, a Plex employee has been clarifying a few of the "it's been hidden here" navigation issues, but has not acknowledged any of the complaints.  Subtitles out of sync? Sorry, offset option removed. Shuffling a show and don't remember what S3E7 is? Sorry, no episode description.  Enjoy the Watch Together feature? Sorry, removed.
I've been left with the impression that Plex wants to drive off lifetime Plex Pass holders, and that they're moving away from their original purpose of self-hosted streaming in favor of ad-supported live & on-demand content.
Fine, mission accomplished, I'm done with this.  There are now free alternatives that are better.   I recommend asking yourself if this is a company worth giving your money or ad-watching time to.

reviews.text:
Okay so the app on Apple TV is GREAT but when I’m watching on my iPhone this thing has a MULTITUDE of problems. The only reason you’re getting 2 stars is because the Apple TV app works perfect. So here’s the problem. 

When I go Picture in Picture to do other stuff on my phone like answer emails check Facebook or just play a game the app works fine. Commercials have an issue starting but whatever. THEN when I revert back to full screen while watching a show or movie the app freezes and then throws me into another 180 second commercial block. I wouldn’t get annoyed by that if I just didn’t get out of an ad block 3 seconds prior. 

Now the other issue if I look passed the additional 180 ad block when the show comes back on it’s totally black with sound playing. Going backwards doesn’t work to fix it. I literally have to leave the episode and start over. And guess what I get when I do that?  That’s right ANOTHER 180 second ad block. But at least the picture issue is fixed after that happens. So FIX the picture and picture issue. It shouldn’t have an issue playing from a smaller screen to a full screen. 

I’m sure if I paid for the app these issues wouldn’t be an issue but I pay for WAY too many services as it is so I don’t mind watching commercials especially for shows I haven’t seen which Plex only has, The Arc if anyone is curious. Please fix this issue so I can give you 5 stars.

reviews.title: I Expect Better in 2026
reviews.text: I’ve been a Plex Pass user for over a decade and I am so sad to finally have to write this review.  With so many streaming platforms out there, you would think the Plex design team would figure out how to make an intuitive media streaming and playback app.  Sadly, the interface continues to be confusing, overly complicated, and often hiding or missing important features.  The downloaded media feature sometimes works, and other times is a complete mess.   The library is difficult to navigate and the playback controls are awful.  If Plex wants to save itself from the open source alternative that everyone is flocking to, they should take a well designed app like AppleTV or Netflix and mirror how they do it.  Also, PLEASE read your support forums and fix the bugs that your users are reporting to you! There are so many bugs that pop up in each new update that it feels like you must have outsourced your development to first-year programming students.

reviews.title: Needs work!!
reviews.text:
Plex has SO much potential and honestly could be way better! Especially because it’s not just for tracking movies/shows, it also has free in app streaming kinda like Tubi, which is a huge plus. The concept is amazing and there’s so much customization, but the app performance and syncing issues make it hard to fully enjoy.

Once you start adding a lot of movies, shows, ratings, watchlists, etc., the app becomes laggy and almost unusable. I constantly get “A connection error occurred” and then can’t use the app again for several minutes. It crashes a lot too, and this has been happening since I first started using it a year or so ago. 

The tracking system also gets really buggy. If I mark something as watched and later rewatch it through Plex’s free streaming service, it starts duplicating entries instead of tracking correctly. I literally have movies showing up multiple times in my watched list, and if I try removing one entry, it removes all of them. Same thing happened with the show “Weeds”, I already had the show marked as watched, but when I rewatched it through Plex, it started individually remarking every episode as watched again, so now I have duplicates of basically the entire series.

Plex genuinely has the potential to be one of the best movie/show apps out there because the features are so good, but the bugs, crashing, syncing issues, and connection errors seriously need attention. 

If everything was working properly i’d give the app a 5/5 
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
